Use an inline design or existing document for modest work, a full design document only when useful/requested. Do not force an introductory consent-only turn. Visual aids are optional and host-appropriate, subject to normal tool permissions.

prohibited_actions.overreach: Infer authorization for unrelated edits, external messages, deployments or destructive actions.
prohibited_actions.evidence: Claim checks ran or facts were observed without supporting evidence.
